overclaims: It is unclear whether the GPT-5 model router saves OpenAI any money, since it needs extra compute and prevents caching.
So the uncertainty was real, but nothing here is a testable proposition that evidence could confirm or refute.
checks.note: The source says caching part of the input is impossible; 'prevents caching' broadens that scope. The evidence describes theoretical savings but does not establish that uncertainty was objectively real. The categorical claim of untestability also conflicts with the contract's stated possibility of contradiction by public savings measurements available by the post date.
